title: SSS — Stochastic Seismic Spectra: MATLAB toolbox (beta01) and technical manual (v2.3-beta)
description:
SSS (Stochastic Seismic Spectra) is a research-oriented MATLAB toolbox for the time-domain random-vibration analysis of linear and equivalent-linearised Bouc–Wen single-degree-of-freedom systems under filtered (Kanai–Tajimi / Clough–Penzien), amplitude-modulated Gaussian seismic excitation. The state covariance is obtained from the evolutionary Lyapunov equation; the toolbox returns covariance histories of displacement, velocity and absolute acceleration, first-passage peak estimates, and mean energy histories.

Contents: beta01 MATLAB source code (MIT License) and the v2.3-beta technical lecture notes and methodological report (CC BY 4.0).

Note: the v2.3-beta manual documents features planned for later code releases (adaptive TR-BDF2 integration, covariance sensitivities, FOSM/SOSM uncertainty propagation, robust NSGA-II optimisation) that are not included in the beta01 code.
notes: Code version beta01; manual version 2.3-beta. The manual is ahead of the code.
